description: Golden MCP call trace for nfl-build `compare` mode. The validator (scripts/nfl-build-checks.mjs) asserts this ordering: the projections_only baseline is built and its provenance read BEFORE the first content call; user confirmation precedes the informed rebuild; the informed rebuild reuses identical settings; pool digests are compared last. Content tools are the only three: nfl_list_content / nfl_search_content / nfl_get_content.
